summary: @ornikar/eslint-config 24.0.9 executes obfuscated Bun-compiled payload at install time
details: package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which runs on every `npm install`. setup.mjs either uses a pre-installed `bun` binary or downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime ZIP from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases and then invokes Bun to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`, a 727 KB `@bun-cjs` bundle obfuscated with a string-array + rotator function (`WV8StW`). The obfuscated bundle is not referenced by any library entry point and only runs via this preinstall dropper. The declared purpose of the package is an ESLint configuration; fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime to execute an opaque Bun-compiled blob is unrelated to that purpose and evades scanners that inspect only Node-resolved sources. The CHANGELOG through 24.0.x documents only ESLint flat-config migration and dependency updates — it makes no mention of a preinstall hook, setup.mjs, math_init.js, or a Bun runtime dependency, indicating the added installer diverges from the declared release history.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
